verdict.rationale: Featurebase markets a workflow feature for SLAs, auto-extending trials and offering discounts, and it auto-notifies users when their requests ship. Webhooks fire on feedback, conversation and status-change events, with HTTPS endpoints, signature verification and automatic retries, but the action logic then lives in the customer's own backend. Missing for 10: documentation of a rule/workflow builder (trigger types, conditions, available actions), evidence that rules can be defined natively without external code, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
